label: Bible Study
prompt: I will _____ and go to my father, and will say unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and before thee,
verse: I will arise and go to my father, and will say unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and before thee,
note: The prodigal's rehearsed speech, worked out while feeding pigs in a far country.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And ye now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall _____, and your joy no man taketh from you.
verse: And ye now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man taketh from you.
note: Sorrow now, joy later — and Jesus promises a joy that no one can take away once it comes.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Let no corrupt _____ proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers.
verse: Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers.
note: 'Corrupt communication' is KJV for rotten talk — Paul's rule is only words that build people up.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Thou believest that there is one God; thou doest well: the devils also believe, and _____.
verse: Thou believest that there is one God; thou doest well: the devils also believe, and tremble.
note: James's sharpest jab: even demons have correct theology — and it makes them shudder, not obey.

label: Don't Play With Me
verse: Abstain from all appearance of evil.
note: 'Abstain from all appearance of evil' — one of the shortest commands in Paul's rapid-fire closing list.
